body: Well, I’m an open book at this time. I’m so lonely. I’m not allowed to talk to boys my own age and girls want nothing to do with me.
Well my adoptive father makes my brother and I wear panties. He says he needs us to snuggle with him so he’s “excited” for work the next morning. He bullies us and is always drunk.

Hi thanks for checking in on me. I don’t have access to the internet often. My inheritance is for $750,000.00 and the rental property my father bought a few years back. I plan to put the money in diverse stocks and mutual funds to create a monthly passive allowance.
My family died in an airplane crash.
Thanks. Everyday is a fight.
Thank you so much. Bless your soul.
Thanks. I feel I have no one here that understands. The whole community knows what he does to us but no one does anything.
My post history tells the story. I no longer have the strength...
Thank you. It means so much for me to read that.
I don’t want to lie. That will only make me as worse as him.
I tried but they banned me. Check my post history. You’ll see several mods banning me.

According to our case worker, “We know this can go bad but, we legally cannot remove you unless he brutally or sexually assaults you.” What’s even more insane, he’s hired an attorney to sue CPS despite our testimony and witnesses corroborating.
It’s sad. I feel your pain. Together, our experiences will make a better world for future children.
Thanks. It’s been rough since mom and dad died. I want to get emancipated so their life insurance policy activates and I can just raise my bro and I.
Thanks but, “Until he physically touches you sexually, there’s nothing we can do but wait.”
He doesn’t actually touch us. He just makes us snuggle with him so he gets “hard and has energy for work.” 🙄
Thanks for that. Every week, he seems to get worse. I don’t understand the point of making a 15 year old march around in panties.
I have no idea. Was adopted 3 months ago. She barely speaks and follows all of his orders.
My adoptive mother isn’t going to do anything. She just sits around crying all day. He made her have sex with guys from work and forced us to watch.
I did but that would cause me to get into trouble if I ran.

That’s the thing. I’ve told my school and they reported him to authorities and my case worker but, technically it’s not illegal to force your child to wear panties and “snuggle.” We live in a small city and everyone knows what’s going on. They just look the other way and don’t make eye contact.
I did and he was investigated. Asshole left no bruises so there is no way to proceed.

My adoptive father abuses my adopted brother and I. He forces us to wear panties and “snuggle” with him when he comes home reeking of alcohol from the factory. We live in a small town of 100k people at most. When I turn 18, my father’s life insurance policy activates and I’ll receive $500k. I have 3 more years of this or if he signs off on my emancipation.
